queer_characters.name: Jared Eamons
queer_characters.notes: Described explicitly as a gay man based on real person Garrard Conley; narrative follows him rejecting conversion therapy ideology and living authentically, treating his sexuality as valid rather than a disorder.

contributor_notes: Based on Garrard Conley's 2016 memoir; adapted by Joel Edgerton with some dramatized/fictionalized scenes. 'own-voices' tag reflects the memoir source but Edgerton's own identity is not stated in the source text — maintainer should verify. Physical abuse (participants beaten with Bibles) and psychological abuse depicted. No subtitle/audio language info provided. Jared's happy/authentic ending is depicted (living openly in NYC) but I did not add 'happy-ending' given the traumatic overall content — maintainer may reconsider.
